assets.title: Fixed Spur Gear Study Kit
assets.description: One original static gear study kit counted as one prop: two continuously meshed thick annular wheels with twelve and eighteen genuine teeth, supported above a chamfered base by two fixed stepped shafts with lower seating collars and upper stop caps. Teeth and roots are part of each single closed gear shell, not attached blocks. Both real through-bores retain finite annular clearance around their shafts. The two wheels are fixed in one offset phase: teeth enter the opposite slot envelope while all opposing gear surfaces retain positive clearance. Every gear is finitely seated on its collar; both shafts are finitely fixed into the grounded base. Five editable closed meshes, four opaque constant PBR colours, no textures or animation. Metres, source Z up, front -Y and ground-centred origin. No clock casing, numbered instruction card, person, motor, extra gear variant or scene. Static visual geometry only. No rotation, continuous meshing, gear ratio performance, involute or engineering accuracy, time measurement, educational effectiveness, mechanical efficiency, loading, manufacture tolerance, assembly-path or safety-certification claim. No compatibility with earlier clock internals. Dimensions describe this fixed visual geometry only.
